summary: Use runtime fallback when Promise.resolve may assimilate an arbitrary object through dynamic then lookup.

requirements.operand: object with unknown then property semantics

target.notes: Perform JavaScript Get(value, 'then'), callability testing, queued thenable invocation, and one-shot resolve/reject semantics.

caveats: Getter, Proxy, or monkey-patched then semantics cannot be represented by a simple Task conversion.
